text:
The plate holds about 3-4 strips of bacon and 8 or so roasted Brussels sprouts.

Bacon: the strips look cooked and fairly thin. Cooked bacon is about 8 g per strip, so 4 strips come to roughly 32 g. At about 540 kcal per 100 g, that is about 170 kcal. Some of the strips overlap and may be 3 or 4 in total, so I'll say about 30 g and about 160 kcal.

Brussels sprouts: they look small and roasted in oil. 8 sprouts at about 12 g each is roughly 95 g. At about 70 kcal per 100 g with the added oil, that is about 65 kcal.

Total: about 125 g and about 225 kcal.
